How It Works

Get your entire alliance claiming in under 2 minutes.

1

Add Your Players

Paste your alliance player IDs. We support bulk import — add hundreds in seconds.

2

Enter Gift Code

Paste any new gift code. We'll queue it for all your players automatically.

3

Watch It Claim

Sit back as codes are claimed for every player. Track results in real-time.

Claim Codes Without Leaving Discord

Add the KS Claimer bot to your alliance server and let officers claim gift codes for everyone — right from chat.

Instant Slash Commands

Type /addcode and the bot claims for your whole roster in seconds.

No Login Required

Officers and admins run commands directly in Discord — no website needed.

Live Results

See exactly who claimed, was capped, or already had the code in-channel.

Role-Based Access

Restrict admin commands to your chosen Discord role or server admins.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this safe to use?
Yes. We use the same official gift code redemption page that you would use manually. Your account credentials are never stored — only your player ID is needed.
How fast is the claiming?
About 5-7 seconds per player. A 100-player alliance takes about 8-10 minutes to fully claim a code.
What happens if a code is already used?
We detect duplicates and skip them. You'll see exactly which players already claimed in the results.
Can I use this for multiple alliances?
Absolutely. You can manage players across different alliances and kingdoms from one dashboard.
Is there a free plan?
You can sign up and explore the dashboard for free. Player slot subscriptions start at affordable monthly plans.
